distribution: Linked from the official NTA host; not mirrored by JEENEETARD.
coverageNote: The NTA catalogue exposes eight unique NEET UG 2024 files: one final answer key, four entries labelled Hindi + English, and three entries labelled English. Full-page visual review found that the file labelled English_2 is actually the 48-page Hindi-English T6 booklet, so it is excluded from this English-only batch. The two accepted English-only booklets are T1 and R1 from the examination held on 5 May 2024. Each accepted PDF contains questions 1-200; pages 31-32 are intentional rough-work pages. Other language editions remain outside this batch and are not replaced with third-party copies.

excludedFiles.reason: Visual inspection shows Hindi and English side by side on every question page and identifies the booklet as T6_Hindi+English, so the NTA catalogue label is not reliable enough for an English-only release.
